cohort: A 27-year-old woman at 24 weeks gestation with Marfan syndrome and a symptomatic abdominal aortic aneurysm.
finding: Endovascular repair as a bridge therapy in a pregnant woman with Marfan syndrome and a symptomatic abdominal aortic aneurysm successfully prevented rupture and allowed for continued pregnancy and eventual delivery.
gest_age: 24 weeks at presentation, 36 weeks at delivery
